scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
Good day, I'm Mishuna, one
of the instructors here in the
Schweicherbil Magic Academy.
By any chance, are you a Sage
or Scholar? Oh... You're not?
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
你好，我是米舒娜，
施韦希比尔魔法学院的讲师之一。
请问，你是贤者或学者吗？
啊...你不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
Oh, that's too bad.
My apologies. But if you
happen to know any, or meet
any in your journeys, please
direct them to me if they haven't heard of the lessons I provide.
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
哦，真遗憾。
抱歉打扰了。但如果你认识，
或者在旅途中遇到任何贤者或学者，
请让他们来找我，
如果他们还不知道我提供的课程的话。

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
I'm sorry to bother
you, and I thank you
for your time. Good
day to you, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
抱歉打扰你了，
感谢你的时间。
祝你一切顺利，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
If you have any Sage or
Scholar friends who haven't
learned the skills from Sir
Barmundt's scrolls, then
please refer them to me.
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
如果你有贤者或学者朋友，
还没有学习巴尔蒙德爵士卷轴中的技能，
请让他们来找我。

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
I trust that you are
finding that these
element based skills
are very useful in battle.
Knowledge truly equates
to power in the long run...
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
我相信你会发现，
这些基于元素的技能
在战斗中非常有用。
从长远来看，知识确实等于力量...

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
Ah, you must have
forgotten what I taught
you somehow. Perhaps
you lost your copy of the
skill scroll I gave you? No
matter, I'll help you remember.
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
啊，你一定是
忘记了教你的内容。
也许你弄丢了我给你的
技能卷轴副本？
没关系，我会帮你回忆起来。

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
You'll be given the chance to
choose which kind of ^FF0000Elemental
Change^000000 skill that you want, even one that you didn't previously
learn, so long as you fulfill
the skill's requirements.
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
你将有机会选择
你想学习的^FF0000元素变化^000000技能，
即使是你之前没有学过的，
只要满足该技能的要求即可。

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
Keep in mind that once
you learn your Elemental
Change skill, you won't be
able to change it. Now, which
skill would you like to learn?
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
请记住，一旦你学会了
元素变化技能，
就无法更改了。那么，
你想学习哪个技能？

scripts.text: Fire Elemental Change
scripts.translation: 火元素变化

scripts.text: Earth Elemental Change
scripts.translation: 土元素变化

scripts.text: Wind Elemental Change
scripts.translation: 风元素变化

scripts.text: Water Elemental Change
scripts.translation: 水元素变化

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
I'm sorry, but you haven't
learned ^FF0000Endow {0}^000000, the skill
required for ^FF0000{1} Elemental
Change^000000. You'll need to learn
Endow {2} or select another
Elemental Change skill.
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
抱歉，你还没有学习
^FF0000赋予 {0}^000000，
这是^FF0000{1}元素变化^000000所需的技能。
你需要学习赋予 {2}，
或者选择另一个元素变化技能。

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
Very well, I shall
teach you the ^FF0000{0}
Elemental Change^000000 skill
and the ^FF0000Elemental Converter
Creation skill^000000. Please remain
still while I chant this spell.
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
很好，我将教你
^FF0000{0}元素变化^000000技能
和^FF0000元素转换器制作^000000技能。
请保持静止，
当我吟唱这个咒语时。

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
%$#@!#$% Yap~~

[Mishuna]
Yap!
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
呀！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've successfully
learned the {0} Elemental
Change skill and the Elemental
Converter Creation skill.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你成功学会了{0}元素变化技能和元素转换器制作技能。^000000

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
Alright, I'm going
to cast a spell that
will help you remember
the skills you forgot.
Don't move, and try to
stay as still as possible...
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
好的，我要施放一个
帮助你回忆
忘记的技能的法术。
不要动，尽量保持静止...

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
%$#@!#$% Yap~~

[Mishuna]
Yap!
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
呀！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou successfully recalled
the Elemental Coverter
Creation skill and are
able to use it again.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你成功回忆起了元素转换器制作技能，
并可以再次使用它。^000000

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
Ah, you've learned these
skills as quickly as I thought
you would. Very well then,
I hope you adeptly use these
talents for the right purposes.
Farewell for now, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
啊，你学这些技能
的速度和我预想的一样快。
很好，我希望你能
善用这些天赋，
用于正确的目的。
再见，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
Good day, I'm Mishuna, one
of the instructors here in the
Schweicherbil Magic Academy.
How may I be of service?
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
你好，我是米舒娜，
施瓦伊希比尔魔法学院的
讲师之一。
有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: I seek new knowledge.
scripts.translation: 我想寻求新的知识

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
Ah, you must be {0}.
I've looked forward to meeting
you. In the noble pursuit of
knowledge, might I suggest
reading the recently restored
scrolls of Sir Barmundt?
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
啊，您一定是{0}吧。
我一直很期待与您见面。
在追求知识的道路上，
我建议您阅读一下
最近修复的巴姆蒙特爵士的卷轴。

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
Sir Barmundt's scrolls contain
knowledge about the 4 elements,
which are Fire, Water, Earth, and Wind. The knowledge of these
scrolls can be applied in the
use of 2 new Sage skills.
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
巴姆蒙特爵士的卷轴中
记载了关于火、水、地、风
四大元素的知识。
这些知识可以应用于
两个新的贤者技能。

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
The first is called ^FF0000Elemental
Change^000000, which enables you
to change a monster's attribute
according to the specific element of the Elemental Change skill
that you have learned.
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
第一个技能叫做^FF0000元素转换^000000，
它可以根据您习得的
元素转换技能的具体属性，
改变魔物的属性。

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
The second is called
Elemental Converter Creation,
which enables you to create
converter items that are required to use the Elemental Change skill.
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
第二个技能叫做元素转换器制作，
它允许您制作使用
元素转换技能所必需的
转换器道具。

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
Although the knowledge of
these two skills has been
lost for years, we've finally
been able to recover most
of it. So, do you think you're
ready to learn these skills?
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
虽然这两个技能的知识
已经失传多年，
但我们终于找回了大部分内容。
那么，您觉得自己
准备好学习这些技能了吗？

scripts.text: Maybe later.
scripts.translation: 稍后再说

scripts.text: Yes, I am.
scripts.translation: 是的，我是。

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
Ah, you must be busy right
now. No problem, just come
back when you think you're
ready to learn. Well then,
farewell and have a good day~
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
啊，您现在一定很忙。
没关系，等您觉得
准备好学习时再回来吧。
那么，再见，祝您愉快~

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
Very well, then. First, you
must learn the Elemental
Coverter Creation skill, which
is essential to learning the
Elemental Change skill.
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
很好。首先，
您必须学习元素转换器制作技能，
这是学习元素转换技能的基础。

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
Please bring the required
materials so that we can
construct a basic elemental
converter in order for you to
learn the skill. Let's see,
you will need to bring...
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
请带上所需的材料，
以便我们制作一个基础元素转换器，
让您学习该技能。
让我看看，您需要带上...

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
^ff00007 Horns^000000,
^ff000012 Rainbow Shells^000000,
^ff000010 Snail's Shells^000000,
^ff00004 Blank Scrolls^000000 and
^ff000010 Scorpion Tails^000000.^000000

[Mishuna]
Alright, I shall be
nexting here for your
return. Remember that we
need these items to create
a converter so that you can learn the skill from my example...
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
好的，我会在这里
等您回来。请记住，
我们需要这些材料来制作转换器，
这样您才能通过我的示范学习该技能...

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
Hm, you still haven't
gathered all of the materials
required to create an elemental
coverter. Let me remind you
what to bring so that you
don't forget next time...
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
嗯，您还没有集齐
制作元素转换器所需的所有材料。
让我提醒您一下需要带什么，
以免您下次忘记...

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
^ff00007 Horns^000000,
^ff000012 Rainbow Shells^000000,
^ff000010 Snail's Shells^000000,
^ff00004 Blank Scrolls^000000 and
^ff000010 Scorpion Tails^000000.^000000

[Mishuna]
Don't forget that we need
all of these items to create
a converter so that you can
learn the Elemental Converter
Creation skill by watching
me demonstrate it for you.
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
别忘了，我们需要
所有这些材料来制作转换器，
这样您才能通过观看我的示范
学习元素转换器制作技能。

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
Great, you brought everything.
Now, let me explain the skill.
The skills you learn as a Sage
determine what kind of elemental converters that you can craft.
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
太好了，您带齐了所有东西。
现在，让我解释一下这个技能。
您作为贤者习得的技能
决定了您可以制作哪种元素转换器。

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
The ^FF0000Endow Blaze^000000 skill enables
you to create Fire elemental
converters. The ^FF0000Endow Quake^000000
skill enables the creation
of Earth elemental converters.
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
^FF0000火属性附加^000000技能允许您
制作火属性转换器。
^FF0000地属性附加^000000技能允许您
制作地属性转换器。

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
^FF0000Endow Tornado^000000 enables
the creation of Wind elemental
converters, and ^FF0000Endow Tsunami^000000
enables the creation of Water
elemental converters. That
all makes sense, right?
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
^FF0000风属性附加^000000允许您
制作风属性转换器，
^FF0000水属性附加^000000允许您
制作水属性转换器。
这些都合乎逻辑，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
Now, your elemental coverter
creation success rate depends
on the level of the Endow Blaze, Endow Quake, Endow Tornado,
or Endow Tsunami skills, and
your abilities.
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
现在，您制作元素转换器的成功率
取决于火属性附加、地属性附加、
风属性附加或水属性附加的技能等级，
以及您的能力。

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
Now, please take this copy
of Barmundt's scroll, and use
it as a reference when you try
to craft elemental converters
when you use the Elemental
Converter Creation skill.
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
现在，请收下这份
巴姆蒙特卷轴的副本，
当您使用元素转换器制作技能
尝试制作元素转换器时，
请将其作为参考。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou have learned the
Elemental Converter
Creation skill by reviewing
your copy of Barmundt's scroll.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF您通过查阅巴姆蒙特卷轴的副本，
习得了元素转换器制作技能。^000000

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
Wow, {0}!
You learned that skill
really quickly! No wonder
people say that you're one
of the best Sages around!
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
哇，{0}！
你学得真快！
难怪大家都说你是
最出色的贤者之一！

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
Now you're ready to
learn the other skill,
Elemental Change. Alright,
I need to prepare a few things
for this lesson, so we'll meet
and discuss this later, okay?
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
现在你准备好
学习另一个技能了，
元素转换。好吧，
我需要为这节课准备一些东西，
我们稍后再见面讨论，好吗？

scripts.text: - I recalled ^ff0000Elemental Converter Creation skill^000000 While I talk to Mishuna! -
scripts.translation:
- 在我和米舒娜交谈时，
我回忆起了^ff0000元素转换器制作技能^000000 -

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
You'll be given the chance to
choose which kind of ^FF0000Elemental
Change^000000 skill that you want, even one that you didn't previously
learn, so long as you fulfill
the skill's requirements.
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
你将有机会选择
你想学习的^FF0000元素变化^000000技能，
即使是你之前没有学过的，
只要满足该技能的要求即可。

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
Keep in mind that once
you learn your Elemental
Change skill, you won't be
able to change it. Now, which
skill would you like to learn?
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
请记住，一旦你学会了
元素变化技能，
就无法更改了。那么，
你想学习哪个技能？

scripts.text: Fire Elemental Change
scripts.translation: 火元素变化

scripts.text: Earth Elemental Change
scripts.translation: 土元素变化

scripts.text: Wind Elemental Change
scripts.translation: 风元素变化

scripts.text: Water Elemental Change
scripts.translation: 水元素变化

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
I'm sorry, but you have not
learned ^FF0000Endow {0}^000000, the skill
required for the {1} Elemental Change skill. Please learn Endow
{2} or select another Elemental Change skill for me to teach you.
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
很抱歉，您尚未习得
^FF0000{0}属性附加^000000，
这是学习{1}元素转换技能所必需的。
请习得{2}属性附加，
或者选择另一个元素转换技能让我教您。

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
Very well, then. Please
bring the following items
so that you can learn the
{0} Elemental Change skill.
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
很好。请携带以下物品，
以便您学习
{0}元素转换技能。

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
^FF000020 {0}^000000,
^FF00001 Payon Solution^000000 and
^FF00001 Morocc Solution^000000. Please
return to me once you have
all the materials ready.
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
^FF000020 {0}^000000，
^FF00001 斐扬水溶液试管^000000 和
^FF00001 梦罗克水溶液试管^000000。
请准备好所有材料后
再回来找我。

scripts.text: - I recalled ^ff0000Elemental Converter Creation skill^000000 While I talk to Mishuna! -
scripts.translation:
- 在我和米舒娜交谈时，
我回忆起了^ff0000元素转换器制作技能^000000 -

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
Are you having trouble
gathering all the required
items? Just in case, let me
remind you of what you need
to bring me to learn the {0}
Elemental Change skill.
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
收集所需物品有困难吗？
以防万一，让我提醒您一下，
学习{0}元素转换技能
需要携带的物品。

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
^ff000020 {0}^000000,
^ff00001 Payon Solution^000000 and
^ff00001 Morocc Solution^000000. Please
don't forget and have the
materials ready for the next
time you see me, alright?
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
^ff000020 {0}^000000，
^ff00001 斐扬水溶液试管^000000 和
^ff00001 梦罗克水溶液试管^000000。
下次见到我时，
请别忘了准备好材料，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
Ah, you're back. I can now
finally teach you about the
{0} Elemental Change skill.
This skill has the chance to
permanently change a targeted
monster's attribute to {1}.
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
啊，你回来了。我现在
终于可以教你
{0}元素转换技能了。
这个技能有机会
永久改变目标魔物的属性
为{1}。

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
Remember that you must
use an elemental converter to
cast this skill, and that it has a success rate, similarly to the
Elemental Converter Creation
skill. So be aware of that.
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
请记住，你必须
使用元素转换器
才能施放这个技能，
而且它有成功率，
就像元素转换器制作技能一样。
所以请留意这一点。

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
Now, {0},
I'm going to cast a spell
that will help you memorize
the {1} Elemental Change
skill. Try to stay still...
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
现在，{0}，
我要施放一个法术，
帮助你记住
{1}元素转换技能。
试着保持静止...

scripts.text:
^3355FFMishuna begins to chant
a strange incantation as
a soft blue glow surrounds
his body and slowly grows
brighter and more intense.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF米舒娜开始吟唱
奇怪的咒语，
柔和的蓝光环绕着他的身体，
并逐渐变得明亮而强烈。^000000

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
@#$%^~ Yap!

[Mishuna]
{0}...
I'm happy to say that you've
successfully memorized the
{1} Elemental Change skill.
I hope that it serves you well
in battle. Farewell for now~
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
{0}...
我很高兴地说，你已成功
记住了{1}元素转换技能。
希望它在战斗中对你有用。
再见~

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
If you have any Sage or
Scholar friends who haven't
learned the skills from Sir
Barmundt's scrolls, then
please refer them to me.
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
如果你有贤者或学者朋友，
还没有学习巴尔蒙德爵士卷轴中的技能，
请让他们来找我。

scripts.text:
[Mishuna]
I trust that you are
finding that these
element based skills
are very useful in battle.
Knowledge truly equates
to power in the long run...
scripts.translation:
[米舒娜]
我相信你会发现，
这些基于元素的技能
在战斗中非常有用。
从长远来看，知识确实等于力量...
